text:
Clara H: Quick one — running final sanity before calibration tomorrow. Noticed the reviewer assignment export shows 23 reviewers without a backup reviewer assigned. That'll be a problem if someone drops out last-minute.

Amanda R: Thanks Clara. Can you paste the export path and a sample row? We'll triage and bulk-fill backups where possible.

Clara H: Export: /internal/people-ops/handbacks/exports/1849991234-no-backup.csv. Sample row: `employee: rachel.k@redwood.ai, reviewer: contract-joe@vendor.com, backup_reviewer: ` (empty).

People Ops Bot: Policy reminder: backup_reviewer recommended for all handbacks. Missing backups flagged as priority for calibration readiness.

Diego M: I can script a best-effort pass: 1) if reviewer has a manager, set manager as backup; 2) else pick peer from same team; 3) email new backups for quick accept. Should I run that? ETA ~15m.

Jess M: Do it but include an opt-out in the email: "Reply 'decline' within 6h to ask for reassignment". And tag reassigned_by_ops in the export so calibration lead knows.

Amanda R: Agree. Also add a column backup_auto_filled=true and reason=manager_fallback or peer_fallback. Keep a paper trail.

Diego M: Running job now. JOB-9002 queued. Will push to /internal/people-ops/handbacks/exports/1849991234-no-backup-filled.csv when done.

People Ops Bot: JOB-9002 started. Affected rows: 23.

Diego M: JOB-9002 complete at 1849991460. 18 assigned to managers as backup, 5 assigned to peers. Emails sent to backups with opt-out instructions. Export saved.

Clara H: Spot-checked a few rows; looks good. Thanks Diego. Jess, can you draft a tiny note for calibration lead saying backups populated and opt-outs may come in?

Jess M: Drafted and sent: "Populated missing backup_reviewer for 23 handbacks (auto-fill). If a backup declines within 6h we'll reassign manually and notify panel. Export link attached."

Amanda R: One more ask: mark any reviewers who are contractors in a new column reviewer_type=contractor so calibrators can prioritize stable reviewers. Can Diego add that in the export?

Diego M: Adding reviewer_type to the export now. Updated export path: /internal/people-ops/handbacks/exports/1849991234-no-backup-filled-v2.csv

People Ops Bot: JOB-9002 update: export updated with reviewer_type column at 1849991520.

Clara H: Great. I'll pass this to calibration lead and close the check. Thanks everyone.

Amanda R: Nice work. Let's add a short runbook item: "auto-fill backups to manager if missing 24h before calibration". Jess, can you add to runbook?

Jess M: Added to runbook and flagged for next cycle post-mortem. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
